A '''tavern''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Grathus]] was owned by [[Xig Rollem]]. When the [[Supreme-Class Servant Droid|''Supreme''-class servant droid]] [[Threna]] was accidentally shipped to Grathus, Rollem put [[Gender/Legends|her]] to work serving refreshments at the [[Cantina/Legends|tavern]]. Threna's polite behavior eventually positively affected that of the establishment's clientele, as well.<ref name="Toria">{{JournalCite|10|Toria Tell's Droid Journal (article)}}</ref>
